title: Numbers on a quotation at their limits

steps.expect: Refused with a message about Validity (days) (allowed 0–3650). Nothing saved; typing kept.
steps.observed: Refused: "Validity (days) cannot be negative. Nothing was saved."; nothing saved; the box still holds -5.
steps.note: The refusal says "cannot be negative" rather than naming the allowed range 0–3650.

steps.expect: Accepted — 0 means the quotation never expires.
steps.observed: Accepted ("Quote saved."); Validity shows 0 days. (0 = no expiry: the expiry sweep only touches validity_days > 0 — SAL-094 step 3 checks it on a sent quotation.)
Refused: "Validity (days) cannot be more than 3650. Nothing was saved."
Refused: "Nothing has been saved — GST % cannot be above 100."
Refused: "Advance % cannot be more than 100. Nothing was saved."

steps.expect: Refused with a message naming "the quantity on line 1"; nothing saved.
steps.observed: Refused and nothing saved, but the screen says "Nothing has been saved — Qty cannot be below 0." — it does not name the quantity on line 1 or say it cannot be negative. (A form that gets past the browser check is refused by the server with "The quantity on line 1 cannot be negative. Nothing was saved.".)

steps.do: Add a discount line with Rate -5,000 on a ₹80,000 quotation.
A discount line larger than the total (Rate -1,00,000).
steps.expect: Refused: "The lines total less than nothing. A discount line can reduce the quotation, not take it below zero."
steps.observed: Refused: "The lines total less than nothing. A discount line can reduce the quotation, not take it below zero. Nothing was saved."

steps.expect: Amount ₹3,999.995 is shown rounded to paise consistently on screen, PDF and Word.
steps.observed: Amounts are rounded to whole rupees, not paise: Stored amount ₹4000. On the form the line shows 4,000; the quotation row reads "1 — Inspection (third-party / TPI) Stage inspection — Line-item order 0.5 Man-day ₹7,999.99 ₹4,000"; the PDF line shows (7,999.99) × → (4,000) and its totals with paise. The rate 7,999.99 is printed as ₹8,000.
steps.note: Word not compared: no quotation Word template in the test data.

steps.expect: Shown with Indian grouping on screen and in the PDF.
steps.observed: Shown as ₹9,99,99,999 on screen and in the PDF.
